comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Underwrites homeowners and residential property insurance sold through independent agents, a P&C carrier model like Kingstone's, though narrowed to coastal homes.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Its specialty commercial property and casualty carrier business, sold through independent agents to businesses, matches Kingstone, though diversified into annuities.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Underwrites commercial property and liability for small and mid-sized businesses in construction, hospitality and retail via agents, closely matching Kingstone's customers.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Core business is annuities, life insurance and retirement plan administration, not property and casualty underwriting for businesses and homeowners.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Online health insurance marketplace earning carrier commissions for enrollments, rather than underwriting and bearing property and casualty risk.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Sells fixed and indexed annuities and life insurance to retirement savers, with no property and casualty underwriting.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Primarily title insurance and mortgage guaranty for real estate transactions, with general P&C only a smaller side line.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: Underwrites commercial and residential property insurance sold through agents, a carrier model like Kingstone's, though focused on catastrophe and specialty risks.

comps.label: C9
comps.reason: Core businesses are life insurance, mortgage lending and cemetery and mortuary services, unrelated to property and casualty insurance.

comps.label: C10
comps.reason: Insurance brokerage and program administration earning commissions, rather than underwriting and carrying insurance risk as Kingstone does.

comps.label: C11
comps.reason: Writes homeowners, auto, commercial multiple peril and workers' compensation for small businesses and individuals through independent agents, nearly identical to Kingstone.

comps.label: C12
comps.reason: Independent insurance agency earning commissions on carriers' policies, acting as a distributor rather than an underwriter bearing risk.

comps.label: C13
comps.reason: Underwrites commercial auto, workers' compensation and property for businesses through independent agents, matching Kingstone's commercial lines, though much larger and global.
